name: Palace of Versailles
tagline: Former royal residence in Versailles, France.

construction.quote: Before the later palace existed, Louis XIII built a modest brick‑and‑stone hunting lodge in 1623.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: It covers about 63,154 square metres and contains roughly 2,300 rooms, around 1,000 of which belong to the National Museum of the History of France housed in the Palace and the Trianons.
scenes.quote: It covers about 63,154 square metres and contains roughly 2,300 rooms, around 1,000 of which belong to the National Museum of the History of France housed in the Palace and the Trianons.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: The park of the Palace of Versailles covers 815 hectares today, compared with more than 8,000 hectares before the French Revolution.
scenes.quote: The park of the Palace of Versailles covers 815 hectares today, compared with more than 8,000 hectares before the French Revolution.

scenes.title: History
scenes.caption: The site of Versailles is first mentioned in 1038 in a charter of the Abbey of Saint‑Père de Chartres.
scenes.quote: The site of Versailles is first mentioned in 1038 in a charter of the Abbey of Saint‑Père de Chartres.

scenes.title: History
scenes.caption: In the 16th century, the lands that would become Versailles were owned by the Gondi family, who were influential at the French court.
scenes.quote: In the 16th century, the lands that would become Versailles were owned by the Gondi family, who were influential at the French court.

scenes.title: History
scenes.caption: Louis XIII acquired part of the land in 1623 and purchased the remainder in 1632.
scenes.quote: Louis XIII acquired part of the land in 1623 and purchased the remainder in 1632.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: The king, the court, and the royal government lived there permanently from 6 May 1682 until 6 October 1789, except during the Regency years (1715–1723).
